OpenSCAD WebAssembly runtime
============================

Version: OpenSCAD 2026.07.24 WebAssembly web snapshot
Archive: https://files.openscad.org/snapshots/OpenSCAD-2026.07.24-WebAssembly-web.zip
SHA-256: 663a3259939ece4bfe28a6a7af2e8b5d87a102209fd28821a79c60257cbf45f0
Source:  https://github.com/openscad/openscad

The runtime is downloaded and checksum-verified by
scripts/fetch-openscad-wasm.sh during local and GitHub Pages builds.
